## Names

<a id="message_ptrs"></a>
### [`message_ptrs`](../../../src/messages.asm#L11) `$43BE-$4487`

*data*

Message pointer table: 101 words, index = message number (A of print_message; the room code calls a message a tile). print_message points data_ptr at message - Y so that (data_ptr),Y with the start offset Y reads the first byte; X = text line (text_line_top_lo), Y = offset in the line (0-39 top row, 40-79 the row below). Message format: one byte per cell, ended by $A0. Cell code = (byte - $20) AND $7F; the code goes to the top row of the text line and code OR $80 (the bottom half of the double-height font) to the bottom row. So ASCII letters, digits and punctuation print as text, and the other bytes select graphic characters.

- **Referred to by:** [`print_message`](actor_driver_text.md#print_message) [`$17EB`](../../../src/actor_driver_text.asm#L66), [`print_message`](actor_driver_text.md#print_message) [`$17F3`](../../../src/actor_driver_text.asm#L70), [`print_message`](actor_driver_text.md#print_message) [`$17F3`](../../../src/actor_driver_text.asm#L70) (+1)
